{{Top}}
An '''ozone chamber''' was a device that was found in resorts and spas. It was an apparatus that produced sterile [[Water/Legends|water]] and [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]. Although ozone was known for its toxic affects, when administered in precise therapeutic doses, it had remarkable healing properties.
